description: Archive (soft-delete) a price book: the book and its grid are hidden from lists and refuse to resolve or quote until restored. Existing run quotes that reference the book are NOT deleted — they retain their recorded price but can no longer be repriced. Reversible with restore_price_book. Requires an operator (unpinned) credential.

bookId.description: The price book id (GUID) to archive.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to see what will be archived (break count, dependent quotes, sourcing profiles) and receive a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is changed until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit the archive.

name: archive_price_book
title: Archive Price Book
